# Fischer Strategy Group

> Revenue strategy consultancy helping growth-stage technology companies build scalable, repeatable revenue engines. Founded by Brian Fischer, a revenue executive with 20+ years of enterprise SaaS experience.

## About

Fischer Strategy Group (FSG) is a boutique consulting firm based in San Francisco, CA. The firm was founded by Brian Fischer, who spent two decades as an operator — scaling Cantaloupe (NASDAQ: CTLP) from a pre-seed startup to $300M+ ARR, growing Parspec ARR 700% in 12 months, and leading ArcSite's pivot from product-led to sales-led growth with 77% YoY booking growth.

FSG works directly with founders, CEOs, and revenue leaders at growth-stage technology companies. Every engagement is led personally by Brian Fischer — no junior consultants, no delivery layer.

## Core Services

- **Go-To-Market Strategy**: ICP definition, market segmentation, pricing and packaging, pipeline architecture, sales process design, forecasting methodology, enterprise GTM planning, land-and-expand strategy, sales org design, founder-led sales transformation, first sales hire strategy, playbook creation, CRM implementation
- **AI-Enabled Revenue Operations & Sales Transformation**: AI sales workflow integration, sales automation strategy, RevOps modernization, CRM enrichment automation, AI-assisted outbound systems, GTM process optimization, tech stack assessment
- **Executive Recruiting & Revenue Leadership Search**: VP Sales recruiting, CRO search, enterprise AE recruiting, GTM leadership assessment, compensation benchmarking, hiring strategy and interview process design
- **Founder & Revenue Leadership Advisory**: Operator advisory for founders and revenue leaders on GTM planning, enterprise deal strategy, organizational scaling, board and investor preparation, executive decision-making
